plan.name: Copy dependency stages as root
plan.summary: Copy dependency installation and check stages into Docker through a tar stream whose files and directories have uid and gid zero, so a watcher running as an ordinary user can use the existing root containers with every capability dropped. Preserve file contents, ordinary permissions, link and special-file refusals, input selection, cancellation and cleanup, and update the three named Docker fakes for the streamed copy without weakening their existing assertions. Add an acceptance test that inspects the actual Docker input stream without a daemon and, with INVARIANT_PLUMBING_DEPENDENCIES_REAL=1, prepares Go, Python and TypeScript parts using the pinned toolchain images and one real dependency each, installs each once with network, runs its test command offline, then prepares again and tests the reused immutable environment without another installation. Update docs/factory.md with the root ownership behavior and the opt-in command, prerequisites and coverage. The merger records the root-owned staging and real preparation test decision, which this plumbing build cannot write under decisions/.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDependencyRootOwnedStagesAndRealPreparation
tests.says: Installation and offline checks receive root-owned tar streams containing only regular files and directories, with the intended bytes, permissions and isolation; with INVARIANT_PLUMBING_DEPENDENCIES_REAL=1, all three pinned language toolchains install a real dependency once, test offline and reuse the same environment without reinstalling, including when the host user is not root.
